headline: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Designer
shortBio: Passionate Frontend Developer specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern UI/UX design. I build fast, responsive, and visually appealing web applications with smooth animations and great user experiences.

children.text: Hi, I'm Vijay Negi, a passionate Frontend Developer focused on creating modern, high-performance web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I enjoy building beautiful user interfaces, implementing smooth animations with Framer Motion and GSAP, and developing scalable applications with clean architecture.

I continuously improve my skills by building real-world projects including portfolio websites, blogging platforms, and full-stack applications integrated with Sanity CMS. My goal is to create products that are both visually engaging and technically robust while following modern development best practices.
